text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a Child with a real attitude.
source_text: You see a Child with a real attitude.

text: Get out of my face, you son of a bitch!
source_text: Get out of my face, you son of a bitch!

text: Get away from me!
source_text: Get away from me!

text: What in the Hell do you want?
source_text: What in the Hell do you want?

text: Where might I meet this Master?
source_text: Where might I meet this Master?

text: To find out what's happening around here.
source_text: To find out what's happening around here.

text: Who's in charge here?
source_text: Who's in charge here?

text: Hey, mellow out! Let's have a drink!
source_text: Hey, mellow out! Let's have a drink!

text: To add your ears to my collection.
source_text: To add your ears to my collection.

text: Me no want Hell! Stupid man!
source_text: Me no want Hell! Stupid man!

text: In Hell, loser.
source_text: In Hell, loser.

text: Do you always ask stupid questions, loser?
source_text: Do you always ask stupid questions, loser?

text: It sure as Hell ain't you, punk.
source_text: It sure as Hell ain't you, punk.

text: What makes you think I want to drink with you, you puke!
source_text: What makes you think I want to drink with you, you puke!

text: Get out of here before I kill you!
source_text: Get out of here before I kill you!

text: 【done】
source_text: 【done】

text: 你看到一个脾气恶劣的教徒。
source_text: 你看到一个脾气恶劣的教徒。

text: 从我面前消失！你这个狗娘养的！
source_text: 从我面前消失！你这个狗娘养的！

text: 滚远点！
source_text: 滚远点！

text: 你他妈的要干啥！？
source_text: 你他妈的要干啥！？

text: 我去哪里找主教？
source_text: 我去哪里找主教？

text: 我来调查这里的情况。
source_text: 我来调查这里的情况。

text: 谁是这里管事的？
source_text: 谁是这里管事的？

text: 别紧张嘛，一起喝个小酒？
source_text: 别紧张嘛，一起喝个小酒？

text: 把你耳朵拧下来挂在我钥匙串上。
source_text: 把你耳朵拧下来挂在我钥匙串上。

text: 偶的娘？你奔奔哦。
source_text: 偶的娘？你奔奔哦。

text: 去死吧，白痴。
source_text: 去死吧，白痴。

text: 你老是问这样的蠢问题吗？猪猡？
source_text: 你老是问这样的蠢问题吗？猪猡？

text: 反正不是你，贱货！
source_text: 反正不是你，贱货！

text: 你怎么知道我会和你这种货色喝酒，烂货！
source_text: 你怎么知道我会和你这种货色喝酒，烂货！

text: 滚！要不我宰了你个兔崽子。
